newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to auction 7-year FRNs on Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: Greece to auction 7-year FRNs on Oct 21.

text.p: Greece will auction 250 billion drachmas of seven-year floaters with the first coupon set at 14 percent on Monday, October 21, the finance ministry said.
The spread is held constant at 150 basis points but the benchmark 12-month T-bill is slashed by 20 basis points to 12.50 percent.

The treasury reserves the right to accept non-competitive bids up to 30 percent of the auctioned amount, it said. It also reserves the right not to accept all or some of the competitive bids to be submitted, the statement said.

It reserves the right to accept competitive bids over the 250 billion drachma amount if non-competitive bids do not suffice to cover the 30 percent allotment. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
